whatsappMessage:
Hi Team RAW Cafe & Lounge,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.0★ reviews with 430+ ratings in Patliputra Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile web presence for table bookings and menu discovery.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food menu showcase, aur special event inquiries integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/raw

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi RAW Cafe & Lounge team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-friendly menu showcase and direct WhatsApp table booking for Patliputra Colony. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual cafe photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
